description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, 2026-10-24), YAML-PP census.  LOUD (the file dies), PRE-EXISTING.  NOT REDUCED: the reproducer is the dist file cut to lines 1-11 + 193-257 (create-preserve + tie-array; scratch/s526w2/p52c.pl, run with tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 p52c.pl).  perl: both subtests ok.  PCL: create-preserve prints `ok 1` (no child rows shown) then "Not a SCALAR reference" at top level.  Lines 1-11 + 238-257 alone (tie-array + tie-scalar) pass, and the first subtest alone passes.  Suspects (untested): the preserved_mapping / preserved_sequence tied containers created in create-preserve (YAML::PP::Preserve::Hash/Array, Tie::StdHash base) leave state that the next `tie @$x` / `@$x = (...)` trips on.  Rows: perl 9, PCL 5 (*PLAN*).

=== DONE (s539a) ===
REDUCED (no YAML::PP, scratch/s539a/m4/q2.pl q3.pl q6.pl q8.pl): a tied container's element holding a reference was copied as a reference TO the reference wherever the copy went through the :tielem proxy -- `my ($d) = @_`, `shift`, `my $d = $_[0]`, `my @c = @tied`, reftype / refaddr -- because the proxy's getter answers a reference as its WRAPPER box (%p-tie-elem-value) and three copy paths stored the wrapper.  FIXED in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: box-set's magic-source arm and %p-array-store-scalar's magic arm copy THROUGH a box the getter answers; p-copy-scalar-arg copies a :tielem proxy with box-set; %p-param-copy never hands out a proxy (a write would STORE through it); %p-fetch-once treats a :tielem proxy as get-magic.  ir-spec (the element-proxy paragraph) states the copy rule.  Guard Pl/t/tie-aggregate-01.t op a:blessed-elem-copy (fails on the base: "Not a SCALAR reference").
BOARD: YAML-PP 52.preserve.t 5/0 no plan rc 255 -> 9/0 of 9 rc 0 (= perl); the *PLAN* row LEFT the baseline by edit.
CLOSE-WITH-ROWS: no board row is keyed #3852 any more.
